name: toggle-invert-stripes
prompt: Diagonal stripes with a checkbox to invert the colors and a slider for stripe density. Use a #define for the stripe angle.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a shader layer with black-and-white diagonal stripes. It has a `uDensity` slider (default 12, range 1–80), a `uInvert` checkbox, and `#define STRIPE_ANGLE 45.0` (degrees) for the angle. I didn't apply it to the project, compile it or render it, because no live Powermove tools were attached to this run.
